008package paint.shared.io.internal;
009
010import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.*;
011
012import paint.shared.io.MainIOInterface;
013import paint.shared.objects.Track;
014
015import tech.tablesaw.api.ColumnType;
016import tech.tablesaw.api.Row;
017import tech.tablesaw.api.Table;
018import tech.tablesaw.columns.Column;
019
020import java.util.ArrayList;
021import java.util.List;
022
023/**
024 * Internal schema-validated table I/O implementation for {@link Track}.
025 *
026 * <p>This class supports CSV reading, strict schema enforcement, entity-row
027 * conversion, and table append operations. External callers must use
028 * {@link MainIOInterface}.</p>
029 */
030public class TracksTableIO extends BaseTableIO {
031
032    // =====================================================================
033    //  TABLE CREATION
034    // =====================================================================
035
036    /**
037     * @return a new empty {@link Table} with the Tracks schema.
038     */
039    public Table emptyTable() {
040        return newEmptyTable("Tracks", Track.Column.values(), c -> c.header, c -> c.type);
041    }
042
043    // =====================================================================
044    //  ENTITY → TABLE CONVERSION
045    // =====================================================================
046
047    /**
048     * Converts a list of {@link Track} entities into a Tablesaw {@link Table}.
049     *
050     * @param tracks list of track objects to convert
051     * @return a table containing the track data
052     */
053    public Table toTable(List<Track> tracks) {
054        Table table = emptyTable();
055
056        for (Track track : tracks) {
057            Row tablesawRow = table.appendRow();
058
059            tablesawRow.setString( UNIQUE_KEY,                track.getUniqueKey());
060            tablesawRow.setString( EXPERIMENT_NAME,           track.getExperimentName());
061            tablesawRow.setString( RECORDING_NAME,            track.getRecordingName());
062            tablesawRow.setInt(    TRACK_ID,                  track.getTrackId());
063            tablesawRow.setInt(    NUMBER_OF_SPOTS,           track.getNumberOfSpots());
064            tablesawRow.setInt(    NUMBER_OF_GAPS,            track.getNumberOfGaps());
065            tablesawRow.setInt(    LONGEST_GAP,               track.getLongestGap());
066            tablesawRow.setDouble( TRACK_DURATION,            track.getTrackDuration());
067            tablesawRow.setDouble( TRACK_X_LOCATION,          track.getTrackXLocation());
068            tablesawRow.setDouble( TRACK_Y_LOCATION,          track.getTrackYLocation());
069            tablesawRow.setDouble( TRACK_DISPLACEMENT,        track.getTrackDisplacement());
070            tablesawRow.setDouble( TRACK_MAX_SPEED,           track.getTrackMaxSpeed());
071            tablesawRow.setDouble( TRACK_MEDIAN_SPEED,        track.getTrackMedianSpeed());
072            tablesawRow.setDouble( DIFFUSION_COEFFICIENT,     track.getDiffusionCoefficient());
073            tablesawRow.setDouble( DIFFUSION_COEFFICIENT_EXT, track.getDiffusionCoefficientExt());
074            tablesawRow.setDouble( TOTAL_DISTANCE,            track.getTotalDistance());
075            tablesawRow.setDouble( CONFINEMENT_RATIO,         track.getConfinementRatio());
076            tablesawRow.setInt(    SQUARE_NUMBER,             track.getSquareNumber());
077            tablesawRow.setInt(    LABEL_NUMBER,              track.getLabelNumber());
078        }
079
080        return table;
081    }
082
083    // =====================================================================
084    //  TABLE → ENTITY CONVERSION
085    // =====================================================================
086
087    /**
088     * Converts a validated Tracks {@link Table} into a list of {@link Track} entities.
089     *
090     * @param table a schema-validated table
091     * @return list of Track objects
092     */
093    public List<Track> toEntities(Table table) {
094        List<Track> tracks = new ArrayList<>();
095
096        for (Row row : table) {
097            Track track = new Track();
098
099            track.setUniqueKey(              row.getString( UNIQUE_KEY));
100            track.setExperimentName(         row.getString( EXPERIMENT_NAME));
101            track.setRecordingName(          row.getString( RECORDING_NAME));
102            track.setTrackId(                row.getInt(    TRACK_ID));
103            track.setNumberOfSpots(          row.getInt(    NUMBER_OF_SPOTS));
104            track.setNumberOfGaps(           row.getInt(    NUMBER_OF_GAPS));
105            track.setLongestGap(             row.getInt(    LONGEST_GAP));
106            track.setTrackDuration(          row.getDouble( TRACK_DURATION));
107            track.setTrackXLocation(         row.getDouble( TRACK_X_LOCATION));
108            track.setTrackYLocation(         row.getDouble( TRACK_Y_LOCATION));
109            track.setTrackDisplacement(      row.getDouble( TRACK_DISPLACEMENT));
110            track.setTrackMaxSpeed(          row.getDouble( TRACK_MAX_SPEED));
111            track.setTrackMedianSpeed(       row.getDouble( TRACK_MEDIAN_SPEED));
112            track.setDiffusionCoefficient(   row.getDouble( DIFFUSION_COEFFICIENT));
113            track.setDiffusionCoefficientExt(row.getDouble( DIFFUSION_COEFFICIENT_EXT));
114            track.setTotalDistance(          row.getDouble( TOTAL_DISTANCE));
115            track.setConfinementRatio(       row.getDouble( CONFINEMENT_RATIO));
116            track.setSquareNumber(           row.getInt(    SQUARE_NUMBER));
117            track.setLabelNumber(            row.getInt(    LABEL_NUMBER));
118
119            tracks.add(track);
120        }
121
122        return tracks;
123    }
124
125    // =====================================================================
126    //  APPEND / MERGE
127    // =====================================================================
128
129    /**
130     * Appends all rows from {@code source} into {@code target} while enforcing
131     * the Tracks schema and preserving missing values.
132     *
133     * @param target the destination table
134     * @param source the source table
135     */
136    public void appendInPlace(Table target, Table source) {
137        for (Row row : source) {
138            Row newRow = target.appendRow();
139
140            for (Track.Column colEnum : Track.Column.values()) {
141                String col = colEnum.header;
142                Column<?> targetCol = target.column(col);
143
144                if (targetCol.type() == ColumnType.STRING) {
145                    newRow.setString(col, row.getString(col));
146                } else if (targetCol.type() == ColumnType.INTEGER) {
147                    newRow.setInt(col, row.getInt(col));
148                } else if (targetCol.type() == ColumnType.DOUBLE) {
149                    newRow.setDouble(col, row.getDouble(col));
150                } else if (targetCol.type() == ColumnType.BOOLEAN) {
151                    newRow.setBoolean(col, row.getBoolean(col));
152                }
153            }
154        }
155    }
156}
